about: The family stage's light and colour calibration under ciao's spots (docs/specs/family-page.md 20), measured on the prototype with its calibrate() hook (prototypes/family-pages/tools/ciaocal.mjs, 2026-10-14) and carried to the port unchanged: the studio at 0.575, the previous matte (roughness 0.62) and gloss (clearcoat 1, roughness 0.03) with the base specular a fifth of a plastic's; a and b per finish are the front case's linear radiance at the sample point (0, -0.25) on the outer back, a x albedo + b per channel, through which each shade's albedo is fitted (studio.ts albedoFit). Re-measure with the stage's calibrate() hook after any change to the lights, materials or models.
check: catalog hex against the rendered pixel at the sample point, largest channel error (2026-10-14): shade 7 matte 24, gloss 39; shade 23 matte 12, gloss 31
